question: Can a semantics-preserving TP=1 adapter expose Gemma 4's tied embedding weight to DFlash greedy verification and unlock the already initialized model-specific draft?

candidate.scope: At TP=1, expose the unchanged tied language_model.embed_tokens weight through the exact vocab-parallel head interface consumed by DFlash, including full-vocabulary shard indices and deterministic lowest-index greedy semantics. Do not duplicate, requantize, or modify the weight.
candidate.unchanged: Target and draft revisions, captured target layers, speculative depth 16, attention backends, target forward, verification algorithm, workload, and target-token acceptance semantics.
candidate.offline_gate: A source-level consumer test must prove the adapter returns the same full-vocabulary logits and greedy token IDs as the tied embedding projection, including ties and boundary vocabulary IDs.

paid_measurement.first_arm: One fresh four-request DFlash diagnostic with accepted-draft, target-forward, verification, HBM, and exact token telemetry.
paid_measurement.conditional_arm: One matched same-runtime AR/DFlash c32 pair only after real drafting and target-exact outputs pass.
paid_measurement.target: Retain any valid positive result; 0.50011928158 s/request or lower is a 20% reduction from the quality-qualified 0.62514910197 s/request result.
paid_measurement.bench_need: One nvidia-h200-sxm with at least 141 GB HBM and 250 GiB disk. Prefer a retained compatible bench; otherwise director provisioning is required after the offline gate.

failure_semantics: The prior diagnostic consumed the unadapted interface. It did not test this adapter. Ordinary source/API/build defects are repaired in place; only an executed exact adapter diagnostic can falsify this continuation.
